Hymn 108: The Lord Is My Shepherd
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: B-flat Major
Composer: James L. Leland
Lyricist/Text Author: James Montgomery
Category: Prayer and Supplication

This is hymn number 108 titled "The Lord Is My Shepherd" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in B-flat Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by James L. Leland and the lyrics were written by James Montgomery.
This hymn is categorized under: Prayer and Supplication.
